description: This file provides functions to compute SHA-256 hashes for inline <script> tags in HTML content to enhance Content Security Policy (CSP). It includes logic to parse HTML, identify inline scripts, hash their contents, and generate a CSP header string including these hashes to restrict inline scripts.

methods.name: hasScriptSrcAttribute
methods.description: Checks whether an opening <script> tag includes a 'src' attribute, indicating an external script.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Generates a Content Security Policy (CSP) header string for the control UI, optionally including hashes of inline scripts for enhanced security.
